sections.description: Comprehensive management system for campus events and organizations at the University of Northern British Columbia.
sections.installation: Upload the plugin zip through Plugins > Add New or copy the campus-manager directory into wp-content/plugins, then activate Campus Manager.
sections.changelog:
2.4.0

  • One Schedule box for event dates: every date is editable, with a per-date status and weekly, two-weekly, daily or monthly repeats. Editing an imported event's date now updates the calendar.
  • Cancelled and postponed events show a badge and their reason in every calendar view, the widget and the event dialog.
  • Subscribe to campus events in Google, Apple or Outlook Calendar through the new calendar.ics feed, filtered by category or organization.
  • Shareable calendar links: view, date, filters and search are kept in the page address, and Back/Forward work.
  • New Events > Settings & Integrations page: health checks, import accounts, API key management, a recent-imports log and the subscribe address.
  • Imports without a status are saved as drafts instead of being published.
  • Fixed the organization-manager restriction script, removed an unimplemented REST route.

2.3.2 (included in 2.4.0)

  • The public events feed returns upcoming events when no view or date range is requested, so signage widgets no longer show an empty list late in the month.

2.3.1

  • Enforce event and organization write permissions across REST and imports.
  • Preserve recurring schedules with validated transactional imports and lossless exports.
  • Fix calendar caching, pagination, date navigation, timezones and keyboard access.
  • Report image-import warnings and preserve EventScrape compatibility.
  • Share frontend assets and add checked builds with separate stable and beta release channels.

2.3.0

  • Fix event import to assign the correct event_category term IDs instead of creating numeric junk categories.
